strings.en: Whew, I'm beat. One thing after another... What the hell is going on?
Hey, Joe. It's not break time yet, you know?
That's right, Big Bro. Once our units are resupplied,
they told us to collect the Einst wreckage, remember?
C'mon, what's the harm? Just a little while.
Thank you for your hard work, everyone.
Yeah, you too, Princess Romina!
I haven't done anything...
Should you lot be slacking off here?
What a noisy guy. I'm trying to rest here.
Noisy!? Who do you think you're talking to!?
Ugh, so noisy. I'd rather go pick up bones.
Let's go, Mike, Lenny.
I've still got a bit of maintenance left on the Blast Dragon...
Hm? Who's that?
Huh, so this is what the inside of the Elshank looks like?
What is all this commotion?
You are... Lady Allenby, I believe.
Y-yeah. That's me, but... being called "Lady" is kinda embarrassing...
Need something?
Hmm. I'm looking for Domon...
I saw him outside with Rain a little while ago.
Domon Kasshu was pretty down, huh...
At times like that, the best thing's getting comforted
by a knockout girlfriend like Rain.
Rain's Domon's girlfriend?
Isn't she? They're always together.
Just 'cause they're together doesn't make her his girlfriend, I think.
Exactly. Some dense guys never notice, even when they're together!
Wh-why're you looking at me!?
No reason~
...I see, we've both got it rough.
...Yeah, pretty much.
Huh? What are you girls talking about?
None of your business~
Yep, none of your business.
Geez, what's with those two? Suddenly all buddy-buddy.
The start of a beautiful female friendship.
Um... Lady Allenby, there's something I'd like to ask...
Yeah, what?
The princess believes this man called Schwarz may be the ninja.
Yeah. His moves really did look like Tobikage's.
Hmm. Come to think of it...
I heard there's a fighter who uses Germanic ninjutsu.
Germanic... ninjutsu?
Then is he the legendary ninja!?
Who knows?
If anyone who uses ninjutsu is a ninja, maybe he is,
but I can't say if he's the ninja from planet Radorio's legend.
I see...
Isn't that good, Princess Romina?
I thought the ninja's trail had gone completely cold at the Iga village,
but there's still a chance.
(...But only Joe and the others can pilot Radorio's royal machines.
What could this mean...?)
So this is where you were, Domon.
Domon?
Rain... I'm leaving on a training journey...
Training?
Because I was so green, I let the Devil Gundam revive.
If I'd been stronger, I could have saved my brother and Master...
Domon...
Got it. I'm coming too.
...You'd get in the way of my training. Stay on the Gandor.
Wha-! In the way!? Who do you think handles
the Shining Gundam's tuning and all!?
I'm part of the Shining Gundam's crew too, you know!
Domon.
Let's go... Rain.
W-wait a sec. We can't just leave on our own.
We have to tell Dr. Hazuki first...
The ones holding Jaburo... are this mystery army?
We're recovering the wreckage now. We'll learn something, Commander.
Who's out doing the work?
The resupplied mobile suit units, including Captain Amuro.
Just in case, the Getter Team's out too.
Big Bro headed out with Lenny a bit ago too.
Allenby tagged along too.
Hey, doesn't that sound fun? Let's go too, Banjo.
Beauty, this isn't a game.
Besides, how can you even want to go look at those creepy things?
Now, now, let's leave this to the Captain.
MS are definitely better suited to delicate work.
That's right.
Don't we have stuff of our own to take care of?
Ladies?
Mister's right. We've secured the skies over Jaburo,
but there's too much we don't know, like who the enemy is.
And we can't just ignore that Devil Gundam thing either.
Speaking of which, I haven't seen Domon around.
Mikamura contacted me. Kasshu and the others
are leaving the Gandor to pursue the Devil Gundam.
Right, they came here chasing the Devil Gundam to begin with.
Domon has to go after his brother and his master, doesn't he.
They'll pursue the Devil Gundam while training for a while.
They'll contact us as soon as they find it.
Whatever.
We came all this way, so let's just storm in, Commander Hazuki!
Koji, this is exactly when we need to act calmly!
It's the opposite. When you're on a roll, that's when you push all the way.
We've come this far. Now we can only go as far as we can.
Right, the situation on the ground is still far from good.
Commander, what's the plan for going in?
Now, wait. Analyzing the enemy comes first.
What a drag. Let's just get goin'.
Juzo, calm down.
No use rushin' it.
Hm, Chris? Commander Hazuki, the recovery team's calling.
Yes, put them through.
...Princess...?
Shaff... I have a bad feeling...
Find anything?
No... What does this mean, Amuro?
What, didn't you just drop it?
Joe, you saw it, right? It definitely...
Vanished...?
Captain Amuro, even the pieces I stored in the Ez-8's backpack...
had turned into nothing but ash-like dregs.
Lieutenant Amada, then the pilots too...?
Amuro, no good. Nothing's left where we shot them down either...
It all vanished without a trace!
...Disappeared? It makes no sense. Then what were they made of...?
Show... let's go back. I hate it here. C'mon, let's go back, let's go back!
Cham, what's wrong? You've been strange since the other day.
But... but those things are...
The voice... wasn't it a pilot's? Could it be... a living thing...
Hm, Kyosuke, what's up?
...No, nothing...
Captain!
Mackenzie, what did Commander Hazuki say...
Whatever the recovery results, we go in on an emergency in 10 minutes.
Everyone, please stand by too.
10 minutes? That's sudden. Will we be okay?
That's the Cyber Beast Force for you. Glad you catch on quick.
Right, all units return to the Gandor and prepare to go in...
...Commen...cing... All is... for the sake...
...!! Again!? Captain...!
Huh!? What!? I can't see anything... Joe!
What the hell!? Lenny, where are you, Lenny!
Hayato! Benkei! What is this!?
Ngh, I can't see a thing!
We can't even separate!
Kyaaah!
Wh-what is this!? Domooon!
Ngh, what is this...!
It's pulling me...!? Kamille!
Fa!
Show, this... it's like that light back then...!
I see... this is...!
...That voice is... taking us...!?
Ugh! This light... what...? Peace...?
Hey, Nie. Will Marvel and the others really be okay on their own?
No one asked them to bring down the Wil Wiph.
Holding them back is enough.
Even so, it's too much to ask!
That may be so...
The Goraon must protect the Gran Garan of the Kingdom of Na.
Marvel took it on knowing full well it was asking a lot.
Captain Abe. How much longer to Castle Uroporos?
We're sailing at full speed, but it'll take a while yet.
Is something wrong, Lady Elle?
...I have a strange foreboding...
Looks like another of Lady Elle's visions...
Blue... the color of the sky... an Aura... Battler...
A sky-blue Aura Battler...? D-don't tell me...!
Yes... I see it... among towering mountains...
Towering... the Karakara Mountains?
...The Dunbine...!? Is Show there!?
...And... strange beings as well...
Wh-what are you talking about!? Lady Elle!?
Aura Battlers... surface machines... beings of great power... inspectors...
Lady Elle!
Please stop! Lady Elle!
Ugh... to the Holy Warrior... We must hurry...!
Marvel... I'm counting on you...
